svg.title: Interference from two broadcast antennas
svg.desc: An overhead view of two antennas sending the same signal. Solid circles centered on each antenna are crests and dashed circles are troughs. Where a crest from one antenna meets a crest from the other, marked with dots, the waves interfere constructively; these points line up along a few directions, shown by arrows: straight up and down between the antennas and along two diagonals on each side.
